scope: Targeted routing support for recurring CUMCM B/C problem structures; model selection still requires problem-specific evidence.

cards.title: Designed experiments and response-surface optimization
cards.baseline: Main-effects linear or low-order regression with replicated-error diagnostics.
cards.candidate: Hierarchical quadratic response surface with interaction terms and constrained optimization.
cards.promotion_threshold: Promote only when held-out or replicated-error evidence improves beyond the predeclared threshold and curvature or interaction is diagnostically supported.
cards.falsification_test: Remove the added curvature or interaction terms and verify that prediction or decision quality deteriorates materially.
cards.fallback: Retain the main-effects model, report a bounded local recommendation, and place the unsupported optimum in model optimization.
implementation_notes: Respect hierarchy when an interaction is retained.
Do not optimize outside the supported factor region without an explicit extrapolation warning.

primary_sources.title: On the Experimental Attainment of Optimum Conditions
primary_sources.authors: G. E. P. Box; K. B. Wilson

cards.title: Bearing-only localization and observability
cards.baseline: Closed-form geometric intersection or nonlinear least squares under an explicit reference frame.
cards.candidate: State-space estimator or batch nonlinear estimator with observability-aware maneuver or formation design.
cards.promotion_threshold: Promote only after observability or sensitivity rank is adequate and simulation recovery beats the geometric baseline under declared angle noise.
cards.falsification_test: Use degenerate or nearly collinear geometry and verify that the method reports weak observability instead of a precise location.
cards.fallback: Return the identifiable locus or interval and prescribe an additional bearing or maneuver rather than inventing range information.
implementation_notes: Separate coordinate convention errors from estimator errors.
Use angle wrapping consistently and report units.

primary_sources.title: Kalman Filter Behavior in Bearings-Only Tracking Applications
Observability Criteria for Bearings-Only Target Motion Analysis
primary_sources.authors: Steven C. Nardone; Vincent J. Aidala

cards.title: Coverage path planning under geometric overlap constraints
cards.baseline: Parallel sweep lines using a conservative constant footprint or local-width approximation.
cards.candidate: Cell decomposition or orientation search with spatially varying footprint and route-connection cost.
cards.promotion_threshold: Promote only when independent coverage checking confirms feasibility and the total length or uncovered area improves beyond the declared threshold.
cards.falsification_test: Recompute coverage with a finer independent discretization and adversarial boundary points.
cards.fallback: Use a conservative parallel sweep with documented redundancy and guaranteed coverage.
implementation_notes: Distinguish line spacing from true footprint overlap.
Include transit and turning segments when the problem asks for an executable route.

primary_sources.title: Coverage for Robotics—A Survey of Recent Results

cards.title: Sequential sampling and downstream decisions
cards.baseline: Fixed-sample confidence interval or one-stage expected-cost decision tree.
cards.candidate: Sequential probability-ratio or Bayesian stopping rule coupled to a finite-horizon decision process.
cards.promotion_threshold: Promote only when type-I/type-II error or posterior-risk constraints are met and expected sample or total decision cost improves materially in simulation.
cards.falsification_test: Simulate parameter values at and near every decision boundary and verify the declared risks and stopping behavior.
cards.fallback: Use the fixed-sample plan and a transparent finite decision tree with conservative parameter bounds.
implementation_notes: Separate evidence acquisition from downstream actions.
Do not reuse a point estimate as if it were known in later decision stages.

cards.title: Compositional-data analysis
cards.baseline: Exploratory ratios and a simple classifier evaluated with composition-safe splits.
cards.candidate: Log-ratio coordinates followed by regularized classification, clustering, or multivariate analysis.
cards.promotion_threshold: Promote only when zero handling is justified and out-of-sample stability or cluster validity improves over the raw-proportion baseline.
cards.falsification_test: Perturb the zero-replacement rule and use valid subcompositions to test whether the interpretation survives.
cards.fallback: Report robust ratios or grouped compositions and avoid ordinary correlations on closed raw percentages.
implementation_notes: State whether zeros are rounded, below detection, or structural.
Interpret log-ratio coordinates, not raw Euclidean distance.

primary_sources.title: The Statistical Analysis of Compositional Data

cards.title: Supply-chain planning with robust mixed-integer optimization
cards.baseline: Deterministic linear or mixed-integer program using central estimates, independently checked for feasibility.
cards.candidate: Budgeted-uncertainty robust MILP or a small, justified scenario stochastic program.
cards.promotion_threshold: Promote only when extreme-scenario feasibility or risk improves beyond the declared threshold without unacceptable objective or implementation loss.
cards.falsification_test: Evaluate both policies on held-out or adversarial scenarios and independently recompute every binding constraint.
cards.fallback: Use the deterministic plan with safety margins and an explicit contingency rule.
implementation_notes: Model recourse only when its timing is operationally possible.
Report implementation cost and a readable policy, not only the optimum.

cards.title: Price-demand, replenishment, and assortment decisions
cards.baseline: Leakage-safe demand forecast plus a fixed-price or myopic replenishment policy.
cards.candidate: Joint price-demand-inventory or assortment optimization with cross-validation and operational constraints.
cards.promotion_threshold: Promote only when chronological backtesting supports demand elasticity and policy simulation improves profit or waste by the predeclared amount under uncertainty.
cards.falsification_test: Compare against fixed-price and no-cross-effect policies on unseen periods and stress elasticity estimates.
cards.fallback: Use conservative replenishment quantiles and a small interpretable price grid with conditional recommendations.
implementation_notes: Do not infer causal price response from confounded observational data without an identification argument.
Treat lost sales and censoring explicitly.

primary_sources.title: Optimal Dynamic Pricing of Inventories with Stochastic Demand over Finite Horizons

cards.title: Longitudinal trajectories and interval-censored timing
cards.baseline: Subject-aware summaries or a simple grouped time-to-threshold estimator with bootstrap uncertainty.
cards.candidate: Mixed-effects trajectory model and interval-censored event-time analysis, joined only when their assumptions are compatible.
cards.promotion_threshold: Promote only when subject-level validation improves and the timing recommendation remains stable across trajectory and censoring assumptions.
cards.falsification_test: Leave out whole subjects, perturb threshold and measurement windows, and compare a nonparametric interval-censored route.
cards.fallback: Use empirical subject-level quantiles or Turnbull-type intervals and state that individual timing is not precisely identifiable.
implementation_notes: Never split repeated observations from one subject across train and test.
Distinguish measurement time from latent crossing time.

primary_sources.title: Random-Effects Models for Longitudinal Data
primary_sources.authors: Nan M. Laird; James H. Ware

primary_sources.title: The Empirical Distribution Function with Arbitrarily Grouped, Censored and Truncated Data

cards.title: Calibrated classification under imbalance
cards.baseline: Regularized logistic regression with grouped or chronological validation and prevalence-aware metrics.
cards.candidate: A better-performing classifier followed by out-of-fold probability calibration and cost-aware threshold selection.
cards.promotion_threshold: Promote only when the predeclared discrimination and calibration metrics improve on untouched validation data and the decision threshold is stable.
cards.falsification_test: Re-evaluate under prevalence shifts, grouped resampling, and an untouched test set; reject accuracy-only gains.
cards.fallback: Use calibrated logistic risk with a transparent threshold and report uncertainty or an abstention region.
implementation_notes: Fit resampling and calibration only inside training folds.
A complex classifier without a significant calibrated decision benefit stays out of the main model.
